$comment: ADR 0040 §2.2: shared/ is the plane-neutral package, admitted because the inventory proved a non-empty population — an empty-but-present shared/ is refused. It owns no capability and carries no dependencies; its one member is pure math used by both planes' benchmark roots. If the registry's shared population ever empties, this package goes with it.
name: neo-agent-brain-shared
description: Plane-neutral helpers shared by the Host-Edge and Cloud packages.
